name: Cleopas
bio: Cleopas, one of two disciples walking to the village of Emmaus on the day of the resurrection, was joined on the road by the risen Jesus, though he and his companion did not recognize him. Cleopas explained to the stranger all that had happened to Jesus of Nazareth, not realizing he was speaking to Jesus himself; Jesus then opened the Scriptures to them, showing how the Christ had to suffer before entering his glory. Only when Jesus broke bread with them at their house did their eyes open to recognize him, just before he vanished from their sight; Cleopas and his companion hurried back to Jerusalem to tell the other disciples (Luke 24:13-35).
